# Text: refund-policy

For a parcel delivered late, customers may request a refund of the delivery fee up to 14 days after delivery. Confirm the tracking history and order number before offering the refund.

For a damaged parcel, request a description and a photograph of the damage before deciding whether to refund or replace the order.

Escalate suspected loss, repeated claims, or conflicting tracking evidence to a support lead. Do not promise a refund before the evidence is reviewed.
